marta: Hey team, confidential request. I9m very sensitive to fragrances and yesterday9s onsite candidate day triggered a bad reaction. We have another onsite panel next Wednesday. Can I request a scent-free private interview room and be excused from in-person panels for the next 3 weeks? I9m worried about being on panels and also about any impact on my perf review.

ryan (Hiring Ops): We can re-route your panel slots to remote interviewers and block a scent-free room for candidates. @megan, can you or someone on the team pick up on-site facilitation next Wed?
megan (Manager): I9ll handle facilitation and take the onsite coordination. Marta, I9ll also mark your interview duties as remote for the period and update the hiring calendar.
marta: Thank you. Also want to confirm this is not something that will be held against me in reviews.
sam (People Ops): Confirmed: temporary accommodations are documented confidentially and should not negatively impact performance reviews. We can add a private note if you want clarity in the review packet. I9ll create the accommodation entry now and notify only HR and your manager.
hr_bot: Action logged: accommodation-created (type: scent-free + remote-panel) for marta (start: 2234567890, end: 2235172690). Notifications: People Ops, manager, Hiring Ops.
marta: Appreciate it. I9ll submit the form and DM any specifics about room needs.
